claim_boundary: A single acetone geometry was evaluated through each registered solvent for both direct half-coupling Route-2 continuum equations. This is a runtime/dispatch and numerical-identity record only. It is not a multi-solvent experimental-accuracy panel, equation ranking, variational electronic-free-energy proof, force/PES certificate, OPT, scan, or MD result.

source_equivalence_audit.meaning: The direct multi-solvent profile implementation and paired execution runners are unchanged between the run commit and this publication commit; documentation/packaging changes do not upgrade the evidence to an accuracy or PES claim.

frozen_method.energy_composition: delta_G_solv = 0.5*<c_MACE-POLAR, f_reac_ddX> + G_PySCF-SMD-CDS; the field-conditioned MACE energy difference is excluded

panel.geometry_policy: one fixed single-point geometry; this is intentionally not an experimental benchmark

disposition.supported_inference: All 11 registered solvent descriptors dispatch through both named equation profiles and meet their energy-only SCF/half-coupling checks on the fixed acetone case.
forbidden_inference: a preference between ddPCM and ddCOSMO from these energies
conservative forces for either pyddx multi-solvent profile
a common stationary MACE-POLAR--continuum free energy
disposition.next_accuracy_gate: Use an immutable experimental multi-solvent panel with licensed geometries and an independently QM-anchored permanent-source/nonuniform-response oracle; do not choose an equation, radius, or scale from this usability record.
